compact/posix/codex/ollama-embed/deepsee.copy:
# Keep generated configuration files out of version control.
echo .chunkhound.json >> .gitignore
# Configure ChunkHound with Ollama embeddings and DeepSeek for research. Embedding and LLM providers are independent — either works without the other. Field details: https://chunkhound.ai/docs/configuration/
# You'll need: DeepSeek API key
cat > .chunkhound.json <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF'
{
  "embedding": {
    "provider": "openai",
    "model": "qwen3-embedding",
    "base_url": "http://localhost:11434/v1"
  },
  "llm": {
    "provider": "deepseek",
    "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
    "api_key": "<YOUR_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY>"
  }
}
CHUNKHOUND_EOF
# Configure Codex to connect to ChunkHound via MCP.
codex mcp add ChunkHound -- chunkhound mcp
# Build ChunkHound's search index for this project.
chunkhound index .
